diary.text: I found a shiny silver hoop and thought it was a treasure! And then I looked at frogspawn and saw tiny movements inside the eggs. The pond was COLD and foggy, and I couldn’t find a twig. Why won’t the phone tell me where the cat is? I’m sleepy and my toes are numb. My teapot feels like home, but I wish I had a blanket.

I found a twig! It was all pointy and brown. I kept it in my teapot. It's my treasure! A spider spun a web round and round. I watched it for a long time. It was so fast! Mrs. Bristle gave me new clothes! Acorn-cap hat, mossy jumper, leaf raincoat, walnut boots, felt coat, dandelion scarf, thistledown mittens. I wore the mossy jumper and leaf raincoat. They were WARM and COZY! I tried to build tools with frost and screws. But they broke. I tried again. They broke again. I'm too cold and tired. My legs are cross with me. Why won't the tools work? Maybe the frost is too slippery. Time to go home. I'm sleepy. I'll dream about the spider's web and my twig treasure.
